#!/usr/bin/env bash
# clear_bash_history.sh
# Clears the bash history file for the root user and unsets the in-memory history.

HISTFILE="${HISTFILE:-$HOME/.bash_history}"

# Truncate the history file
> "$HISTFILE"

# Clear the in-memory history for any running bash sessions (best-effort)
history -c 2>/dev/null || true

echo "[$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')] bash history cleared: $HISTFILE"
